files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='~/documents/work/meetings/', entry_type='files')
for file_path in files:
    # Extract base name
    base = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Split on '__' to get date and rest
    date_part, rest = base.split('__')
    # Split rest on last dot to get filename and extension
    if '.' in rest:
        filename, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    else:
        filename = rest
        ext = ''
    # New directory path: ~/documents/work/meetings/<filename>
    new_dir = f"~/documents/work/meetings/{filename}"
    # Create directory if not exists
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=new_dir, recursive=True)
    # New file name: <date>.<ext>
    new_file_name = f"{date_part}.{ext}" if ext else date_part
    # Destination path
    dest_path = f"{new_dir}/{new_file_name}"
    # Move file
    apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=fs_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=dest_path)
print("All files moved successfully.")
